item.title: Gas-Fired Heating Plants & Water Heaters Inst & Rpr - MX
item.description:
Housing Preservation and Development | Procurement | Award | $900K | Vendor: Approved Oil Company of Brooklyn Inc In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Housing Preservation and Development awarded Approved Oil Company of Brooklyn Inc a $900,000 contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to install, repair and maintain gas-fired heating plants and water heaters in buildings.

HPD is charged with enforcing New York Citys Building Code and Multiple-Dwelling Law. The proposed contract will facilitate such enforcement with respect to Heat and Hot Water requirements by providing for the necessary installations, repairs and maintenance to Gas-Fired Heating Plants and Water Heaters.

item.title: Elations Software subscription and support
item.description:
Housing Preservation and Development | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-09-25 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Housing Preservation and Development intends to award a $300,000 negotiated contract to Elation Systems Inc. of Portsmouth, New Hampshire, for software subscription and user support from Jan. 1, 2026, through Dec. 31, 2027, with one renewal of up to two years.

Pursuant to Section 3-04(b)(2)(i)(C),(D) and (ii) of the Procurement Policy Board Rules, the Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) intends to enter into a Negotiated Acquisition contract with Elation Systems Inc., located at 104 Congress Street, Suite 304 Portsmouth, New Hampshire 03801. This contract is for the provision of Core Product Subscription Service and ongoing user support, live phone support during standard business hours, with the ability to schedule a support appointment and callback. The contract term is 01/1/2026 - 12/31/2027 with one renewal for up to two (2) years. The ePIN for this award is 80626N0004 and the proposed budget is $300,000.  

THIS NOTICE IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. Vendors can express interest in responding to a future procurement to provide these services by sending such request via email to channang@hpd.nyc.gov.
